jobs.description:
About the role

As Process Engineer Lithography, you will be responsible for ensuring stable, capable, and reproducible lithography processes in a high-volume semiconductor manufacturing environment. You will drive process improvements, solve complex technical challenges, support the introduction of new technologies, and work closely with production, maintenance, quality, and development teams to achieve excellence in safety, quality, productivity, and cost performance.

This is your new role

- Ensure stable, capable, and reproducible lithography processes in daily semiconductor manufacturing operations
- Monitor and improve process performance using SPC, process capability indicators, and manufacturing data analysis
- Investigate process deviations, non-conforming lots, and yield excursions and drive sustainable corrective actions
- Identify process-related quality issues and support continuous yield and defect reduction initiatives
- Support root-cause analysis activities using structured problem-solving methodologies such as 5Why and 8D
- Define, execute, analyze, and document experiments to improve process capability, productivity, quality, and cost performance
- Support qualification, release, and implementation of new processes, materials, and equipment
- Contribute to process change management, industrialization projects, and technology transfers into production
- Create and maintain process documentation, work instructions, OCAPs, specifications, and training materials
- Conduct technical training and knowledge sharing for production teams
- Participate in FMEA activities and support risk assessment and mitigation measures

This is you

- University degree in Physics, Chemistry, Electrical Engineering, Materials Science, Microsystems Engineering, or a comparable technical discipline
- First professional experience in semiconductor manufacturing, process engineering, or a comparable high-tech production environment is advantageous
- Knowledge of lithography processes and semiconductor manufacturing technologies is desirable
- Strong analytical thinking skills combined with a structured and systematic working approach
- Passion for solving technical problems and driving continuous improvement
- Ability to manage multiple tasks and priorities in a dynamic manufacturing environment
- Strong communication and teamwork skills
- High level of ownership, initiative, and accountability
- Practical mindset combined with attention to detail and quality orientation
- Good German and English communication skills, both written and spoken

About us

Definition working student

Working students are students who are enrolled at a University or some other institution of higher education, and who are employed in a reasonably long, fixed-term position parallel to their studies. This position must not be confused with an internship or with the possibility of writing a final thesis.

This employment usually takes place directly on the company's premises. A working student's main focus remains on their studies, which is why, during term-time, working students are not allowed to work more than 20 hours per week.

Working students therefore usually work near their place of study, so as to conveniently combine studying and employment.

jobs.description:
Work Schedule
Standard (Mon-Fri)

Environmental Conditions
Laboratory Setting, Some degree of PPE (Personal Protective Equipment) required (safety glasses, gowning, gloves, lab coat, ear plugs etc.), Will work with hazardous/toxic materials

Job Description

Thermo Fisher Scientific Inc. is the world leader in serving science, with annual revenue of approximately $40 billion. Our Mission is to enable our customers to make the world healthier, cleaner and safer. Whether our customers are accelerating life sciences research, solving complex analytical challenges, increasing productivity in their laboratories, improving patient health through diagnostics or the development and manufacture of life-changing therapies, we are here to support them. Our team  of more than 100,000 colleagues delivers an unrivaled combination of innovative technologies, purchasing convenience and pharmaceutical services through our industry-leading brands, including Thermo Scientific, Applied Biosystems, Invitrogen, Fisher Scientific, Unity Lab Services, Patheon and PPD.

Location/Division Specific Information

We are a research, development, and production site in Bremen currently with about 500 employees whose “high-end” measurement and analysis instruments (mass spectrometers) are used in research and science worldwide. Our innovative products in the fields of Life Sciences MS and Inorganic MS, as well as T  Elemental Analysis, are among the leading products globally in their respective markets.

Join our collaborative team at Thermo Fisher Scientific as an R&D Lab & Instrumentation Technician, where you will provide hands-on support for R&D laboratory operations and instrumentation. In this role, you will help ensure that analytical instruments, materials, samples, and data acquisition workflows are ready for reliable and reproducible measurements. Working closely with scientists, engineers, and cross-functional teams, you will contribute to efficient laboratory operations, instrument readiness, development activities, and the rollout of new solutions.

A day in the Life:

The R&D Lab & Instrumentation Technician supports daily laboratory operations by ensuring instruments, materials, and workflows are ready for reliable data generation. This role focuses on routine instrument support, solution preparation, data acquisition assistance, and documentation, enabling scientists and engineers to produce high-quality, reproducible results in a safe and efficient laboratory environment. This is an on-site Bremen role that includes regular work in the R&D lab and, when required, line-side support in production test areas during iterative development rollouts.

Instrument Operation & Maintenance

- Support readiness and uptime of laboratory instrumentation through routine checks, basic troubleshooting, and scheduled maintenance activities.
- Monitor system performance and document deviations that may impact data quality or reproducibility.

Sample Handling & System Support

- Maintain sample handling systems and associated fluidics or interfaces through routine cleaning, replacement, and verification.
- Manage waste handling and disposal in accordance with laboratory procedures and safety requirements.

Solution Preparation & Laboratory Readiness

- Prepare routine solutions, standards, blanks, and reagents following established protocols.
- Maintain an organized and well-stocked laboratory, including consumables, materials, and calibrated tools.

Data Acquisition Support

- Execute routine data acquisition workflows as defined by established protocols or lab books.
- Set up runs, monitor progress, and ensure correct transfer, naming, and storage of raw data files.
- Support software rollout verification on lab and production test systems by performing defined manual setup checks, capturing required metadata, and escalating failures quickly.

Data & Metadata Management

- Organize raw data and associated metadata according to defined standards to ensure traceability and reproducibility.
- Perform basic quality checks to verify data completeness and expected signal behaviour.
- Document instrument configurations and note deviations from standard setups.

Operational & Throughput Support

- Support laboratory throughput by managing sample queues, loading automated systems, and coordinating instrument availability.
- Clean and prepare labware and materials suitable for analytical measurements.
- Safety, Compliance & Documentation
- Follow laboratory safety, chemical hygiene, and waste disposal procedures.
- Maintain accurate maintenance, calibration, and operational logs to support compliance and audits.

Additional Responsibilities (as needed)

- Assist with method validation, development studies, or generation of standardized datasets.
- Support basic data checks or preprocessing using established tools or scripts.

Keys to Success:

Education

- Bachelor’s degree in analytical chemistry, chemistry, biochemistry, biology, or a related scientific field, or equivalent (minimum 3 years) hands-on laboratory experience in a routine analytical chemistry laboratory.

Experience

- Experience working in a laboratory environment following written procedures and safety protocols.
- Strong attention to detail and ability to accurately document work.

Knowledge, Skills, Abilities

- Ability to work on-site in Bremen and follow laboratory and production-area procedures (PPE, chemical hygiene, documentation).
- Ability to manage routine tasks independently and prioritize work in a shared laboratory setting.
- Proficiency with basic computer tools (e.g., data entry, file organization, spreadsheets).
- English fluency.

What we offer:

- Employment with an innovative, future-oriented organization
- Outstanding career and development prospects
- Company pension scheme and other fringe benefits
- Exciting company culture which stands for integrity, intensity, involvement, and innovation

Join us in shaping the future of our industry and make a significant impact through your technical skills and hands-on contribution by applying online with your CV and Motivation Letter including possible start date and salary expectations.

At Thermo Fisher Scientific, each one of our 100,000 extraordinary minds has a unique story to tell. Join us and contribute to our singular mission—enabling our customers to make the world healthier, cleaner and safer.

Institute of Physiology and Cell Biology. Starting date: as soon as possible, at the latest September 1,2026.

Area of responsibility

The Institute of Physiology and Cell Biology aims to recruit a highly motivated post-doctoral scientistto join the Cell Biology group, headed by Prof. Dr. Sjoerd van Wijk. We study how ubiquitination andautophagy control cell survival, programmed cell death, inflammation and cell differentiation inbroad pathophysiological settings, including oncology and infection. For this, human and animalpre-clinical experimental systems, including cell lines, primary cells, organoids and iPSC-derivedcells, will be integrated with cell biology with biochemistry, molecular biology and omicsapproaches, including CRISPR/Cas9 gene editing, super-resolution and confocal microscopy andmass-spectrometry. For examples of recent research, see Wächtershäuser et al, Signal TransductTarget Ther, 11(1):204; Zein et al, Autophagy, 21(5):1075-1095 and Weinelt et al, Cell Death Dis,15(1):77.

The position will be closely involved in shaping the research group, setting up the lab and planningand performing independent research at the interface of cell biology, biochemistry and molecularbiology with imaging and computational data analysis. The successful candidate will play centralroles in collaborations between different scientific and clinical research groups and in developinginnovative approaches in comparative cell biology to improve animal and human health. Theposition furthermore combines opportunities for teaching, scientific and academic qualification(Habilitation) and the development of independent research projects within the scope of the group.

Key Focus Areas:

• Independent experimental scientific research in comparative cell biology.

• Teaching and supervision of Bachelor, Master and PhD students/Habilitation.

• Coordination of lab setup and daily running.

• Contribution to the development and implementation of integrative analytical approaches forcell biology, biochemistry and molecular biology, incl. multi-omics, CRISPR/Cas-basedapproaches, imaging and bioinformatic image analysis.

• Support in the analysis of large datasets (e.g., RNA-seq, single-cell data and imaging).

• Support in the preparation of scientific publications and grant applications, for example for theGerman Research Foundation.

• Organization of scientific exchange activities, workshops and project meetings.

Recruitment requirements:

• A university degree and doctoral degree/PhD in (Molecular) Cell Biology, Biochemistry, MolecularBiology, Biology, Veterinary Medicine ("Approbation"), or a related discipline.

• Excellent written and spoken German and English language skills.

• Experience with, or strong interest in, multiscale imaging, CRISPR/Cas-based methods andprimary cell/tissue culture (organoids).

• Basic knowledge in the analysis of high-dimensional biological datasets, particularly microscopicdatasets.

• Knowledge of additional disciplines, including systems biology, gene regulation, epigenomics ormultiscale data integration, is advantageous.

Required professional knowledge and personal skills:

• Ability to communicate complex scientific concepts across disciplinary boundaries.

• Independent, structured and solution-oriented working style.

• Excellent organizational, communication and teamwork skills.

• Willingness to contribute to scientific coordination, develop independent research questions andparticipate in the preparation of publications and grant applications.

• Curious, strong analytical and conceptual thinking skills combined with the ability to developinnovative solutions.

• Flexibility and willingness to rapidly familiarize oneself with new technologies and researchareas.

As a Product Quality Engineer, you will be expected to step into the game and display your excellent quality mindset to help drive our innovations beyond industry standards

What you will do

- Represent the Quality Management within the development team
- Correlate the SiC failure mechanisms with reliability measures to be implemented into the product quality
- Support the definition and execution of qualification activities for SiC product developments
- Contribute to the implementation of quality procedures and quality standards (Nexperia, JEDEC, AEC, and customer-specific) within projects
- Support the development, review, and verification of final test specifications
- Promote quality awareness and best practices to internal and external stakeholders
- Support customer requests and complaints handling activities
- Contribute to the identification and resolution of quality gaps in the product creation process
- Support the definition of qualification requirements and qualification of manufacturing processes

What you will need

- Master’s degree in Electronics Engineering, Physics or a similar discipline
- Experience in a similar position is desirable and experienced in wafer fab and assembly processes preferred
- Knowledge in semiconductor physics as well as in semiconductor applications in the SiC domain
- First knowledge of international quality standards and policies e.g. AEC-Q101, AQG 324
- Familiar with measurement methods and equipment as well as device testing environments
- Familiar with standard software tools (e.g. Office), problem solving techniques
- High-quality mindset and ability to work under pressure
- Fluent spoken and written English skills
- Strong know how in statistical data analysis
- Good communication and presentation skills
- Good team player and willingness to travel
- Assertiveness and demonstrated influencing skills
- Open mindset, which welcomes changes and views problems as opportunities

About the role

At Nexperia, we build around 100 billion essential semiconductors a year. These microchips are a crucial part of cars, mobiles, watches, white goods, mobility solutions – you name it. It is more than likely that all your gadgets carry one or more Nexperia chips.

We are headquartered in the Netherlands and have Frontend and Backend production sites across the globe.

Our Procurement is organized in a global matrix structure. We are an international team equipped with many years of solid industry knowledge and you will find it easy to integrate in our team if you identify with our working principles: take ownership, drive with perseverance, be efficient, and enjoy what you do.

- actively involving yourself in system and process related improvement projects.

- give support to team colleagues as well as development to the team.

- a commercial degree and >10 years of experience in semiconductor or similar industries.
- proven track record of sourcing roles.
- excellent English speaking and communication skills amongst various groups of stakeholders, also across borders (Tier 1+2 sites).
- proven negotiation and analytical skills.
- capability of thinking out of the box while continuously challenging the status quo.
